```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create example DataFrame (replace with your data source)
df = nw.from_native(pd.DataFrame({
    "store": ["A", "B", "A", "B", "A"],
    "revenue": [100, 200, 150, 250, 120],
    "items": [10, 20, 15, 25, 12]
}))

# Compute per-store statistics
result = df.group_by("store").agg(
    nw.col("revenue").sum().alias("total_revenue"),
    nw.col("items").mean().alias("mean_items")
)

print(result)
```
